finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now reads the new name and still accepts the old one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the backoff flag was missing. The new config loader leaves unset flags empty. Missing now means off, matching the old behaviour.

`node build.js` finishes with 0 errors, exit code 0.

The 8 remaining warnings are noise. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that are not in this project. Only `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js` exist here, so I can't touch the rest.
